about: Hand-built, park-LEVEL camping from each state's official park pages (researched Oct 24 2026 and NOT re-checked park by park). One entry per park, at the park's own coordinates (from our POTA park data). 'Likely/verify' entries were left out. Row = [id, name, lat, lon, kind, parkRef, officialParksPage, reservePage, whatItHas]. Separate from data/campstate (the weekly GIS bot) so the bot never overwrites it. Oct 25: for CO IL NE VT MO AL, parks with official GPS points from the state's own layers show those points instead of the park-level row. Point rows: [id,name,lat,lon,kind,parkRef,parksPage,reservePage,detail,'point','confirmed'|'label only',km from park pin,source layer]; park-level rows end with 'park'. 'label only' = the layer has no campground name (name built from site numbers or type). Rows matched only by distance (CHECK) are kept out in data/campstate-manual/review-points.json.
